recipe.name: P3 Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home, then the facts that make it true.

en.primary_text: Reefer OTR hauling produce from the valley to the Midwest. Out 2 weeks, home 4 days — every run, on schedule. Starting at $0.70 per mile, up to $0.78 per mile. Must be age 23 with 2 years of experience. 401k and rider policy included.
en.headline: Know when you're home.
